title: Quaintly Flaky Jamaican Chicken Stew
description: A savory and adventurous Jamaican dish featuring tender chicken and flaky crust, cooked to perfection in a clay pot. This stew is gluten-free friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, bicarbonate of soda, and a pinch of salt.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Heat a couple of tablespoons of oil in the clay pot over medium heat.
Brown the chicken thighs in the clay pot, then set them aside.
Add more oil to the clay pot if necessary, then saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the scotch bonnet peppers, thyme, salt, and black pepper to the clay pot and cook for a minute.
Add the chicken broth and coconut milk to the clay pot, stirring to combine.
Return the chicken thighs to the clay pot and bring the stew to a simmer.
Cover the clay pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew for 30 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
